description: A strip of linen or cloth set into the inner hinge in place of leather. Because it can be thinner while still holding, it gives a stronger joint than a leather one, though with a plainer appearance.
name: cloth joint

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter V, p.88. Internet Archive.
